welfare.title: League relief payment
welfare.body: The league office noticed your bank balance and then noticed the {poor} balance, and decided the two should meet. {amt} has been moved to the {poor} to keep their lights on. Everyone agrees this is "revenue sharing." Nobody asked you.

welfare.title: Mandatory revenue sharing
welfare.body: Commissioner's orders: clubs with cash share with clubs without. You were chosen, the {poor} were chosen to receive it, and {amt} changed hands before lunch.

welfare.title: Assessment for the league welfare fund
welfare.body: A new rule says the club with the most cash helps the club with the least. That makes you the donor and the {poor} the lucky recipient. {amt} has been sent, with the league's thanks and no receipt.

welfare.title: Keeping the {poor} afloat
welfare.body: The league cannot afford to lose another franchise, so it is making you pay for the one in the worst shape. {amt} to the {poor}. A thank-you note may or may not follow.

bills.title: Back taxes
bills.body: The county found a form from three years ago that nobody filed. They also found a calculator. You owe {amt}, already paid out of the account.

bills.title: Property reassessment
bills.body: The assessor drove past the stadium, looked at the new paint, and reassessed it. {amt} came out of the account.

bills.title: Amusement tax audit
bills.body: The state audit says "football" counts as "amusement." {amt} has been withdrawn, with a thank-you card.

bills.title: Business license "renewal"
bills.body: Your license was never really expired, but it is now. The fee for fixing it was {amt}.

bills.title: Payroll tax mix-up
bills.body: The Accountant swears this was not their fault. The state disagrees, to the tune of {amt}.

bills.title: Environmental fee
bills.body: Someone measured the runoff behind the concession stand. It is legally a creek now. {amt} to the water board.

bills.title: Slip-and-fall lawsuit
bills.body: A fan slipped on a nacho cheese puddle near gate 3 and has a very persuasive lawyer. Settled for {amt}.

bills.title: Naming-rights dispute
bills.body: A man named Dale claims the {team} stole his idea for a field name. Mediation was short and expensive: {amt}.

bills.title: Mascot injury claim
bills.body: The mascot costume company says the mascot was "used beyond its rated hug capacity." Settlement: {amt}.

bills.title: Neighbor noise complaint
bills.body: The {town} homeowners' association won its case about the post-game fireworks. You paid {amt} and promised quieter fireworks.

bills.title: Trademark letter
bills.body: A restaurant in another state owns "Gridiron Grill" and would like a word. Then {amt}.

bills.title: Former employee suit
bills.body: A part-time ticket taker says he was promised a free hot dog every game, in writing, on a napkin. The napkin held up. {amt}.

bills.title: Photographer's claim
bills.body: A photo of the mascot from 2019 is somehow worth {amt} in court. The photographer is thrilled.

bills.title: Contract misunderstanding
bills.body: A vendor says a handshake in the parking lot was a contract. The judge agreed with the handshake. {amt}.

bills.title: Bleachers inspection failed
bills.body: The inspector bounced on the bleachers once and then did not bounce again. Repairs and re-inspection: {amt}.

bills.title: Stadium lights
bills.body: Half the lights went out during a night game that was not a night game. Electrician, parts and a bigger ladder: {amt}.

bills.title: Field drainage
bills.body: The sprinkler pipes and the drain pipes turned out to be the same pipe. The fix cost {amt}.

bills.title: Scoreboard meltdown
bills.body: The scoreboard has been reading "HOME 8 GUEST 8" since June. The replacement cost {amt}.

bills.title: Roof leak at the clubhouse
bills.body: It rained indoors. It rained near the equipment. Repairs: {amt}.

bills.title: Parking lot repaving
bills.body: A sinkhole swallowed the VIP spot. It had a sign on it. Paving and a new sign: {amt}.

bills.title: Team bus breakdown
bills.body: The team bus finally gave out on a hill outside {town}. A new transmission (and a new attitude) cost {amt}.

bills.title: Locker room plumbing
bills.body: Nobody wants to talk about what the plumber found. The bill for finding it was {amt}.

bills.title: Health department fine
bills.body: The inspector found a hot dog that predates the current owner. Fine and cleanup: {amt}.

bills.title: Fire code citation
bills.body: The fire marshal counted the exits, then counted them again, and then wrote you a ticket for {amt}.

bills.title: League fine
bills.body: The league fined the {team} {amt} for "conduct unbecoming" after the halftime parade float incident. The float is fine.

bills.title: Noise permit
bills.body: It turns out the band needs a permit for "percussion after 9 p.m." {amt}, plus a stern letter to the drummer.

bills.title: Sign ordinance violation
bills.body: The billboard on the highway was two feet over the legal size. The city is taking {amt} and two feet.

bills.title: Equipment recall
bills.body: The helmet manufacturer recalled a batch of straps. Replacements and shipping: {amt}.

bills.title: Turf company invoice
bills.body: The field supplier found an old invoice from before your time. Interest included, it is {amt}.

bills.title: Ticketing system crash
bills.body: The online ticketing system sold every seat to three people each. Refunds, apologies and a consultant: {amt}.

bills.title: Insurance premium jump
bills.body: The insurer noticed the club is doing well and decided the {team} should pay for it. Premium increase: {amt}.

bills.title: Uniform order mistake
bills.body: The shipment of jerseys arrived in a color nobody ordered, a size nobody wears, and with a name nobody recognizes. Reorder: {amt}.

bills.title: Concession supplier price hike
bills.body: Hot dog prices are up and so is the supplier's confidence. Contract adjustment: {amt}.

bills.title: Town festival "donation"
bills.body: The {town} festival committee knew you had it and asked nicely. A donation of {amt} went out before you could say no.

bills.title: Alumni dinner
bills.body: A booster dinner you were not planning to host was, apparently, yours. Catering, the venue and a very long toast: {amt}.

bills.title: Parade float disaster
bills.body: The {team} float lost a wheel, a banner and the band. Repairs, a tow and apologies to three storefronts: {amt}.

bills.title: Goat on the field
bills.body: A goat got onto the field during practice. The goat is fine. The owner of the goat wanted {amt} and a signed ball.

bills.title: Charity gala embarrassment
bills.body: The silent auction ended up louder than planned. Thanks to a clerical mistake the club "won" the trip for twelve, {amt}.

bills.title: Owner's cousin's consulting
bills.body: A cousin of someone important sent an invoice labeled "strategy." Nobody saw any strategy. You paid {amt} anyway.

bills.title: Storm damage
bills.body: A storm took the tent, the banners and half the practice field with it. Cleanup and replacement: {amt}.

bills.title: Software license
bills.body: The scouting software subscription auto-renewed at a price that has to be a typo. It was not: {amt}.

bills.title: Medical bills pile-up
bills.body: A few emergency room visits from last season finally found their way to the front office. Total: {amt}.

bills.title: Bank error, in the bank's favor
bills.body: The bank is very sorry about the error. It is not returning the {amt}.
